# A func prop given no default is the zero func of its type, whose parameters
# nothing reads and are all named `_`. Go and Kotlin bind the name any number
# of times in one list; JavaScript binds it once, so the bundle of a component
# html builds at run time refused `props.pick ?? ((_, _) => …)` until the
# second was named `_1`.
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o out p.sngl
exists out/server.go

-- p.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component show(pick func(string, int) int) ui.node {
    var taps = 0

    ui.button(text="{pick("a", taps)}", @click { taps += 1 })
}

component page ui.node {
    var on = false

    ui.button(text="Show", @click { on = !on })
    if on {
        show(pick=func(s string, n int) => n)
    }
}

ui.window {
    page
}
